title: MASTER FORMULA RECORD

approved_bill_of_materials.bom_note: Total batch charge: 455.0 kg raw material per 500 kg theoretical tablet output (balance accounted for by coating suspension solids and in-process moisture loss). BOM ratio approved per Formulation Development Report FDR-PCM500-07.

line_clearance_requirements: Line clearance shall be documented and QA-verified for EVERY piece of equipment used at any manufacturing or packaging stage prior to use, including granulation, drying, blending, compression, coating, and primary/secondary packaging equipment. A clearance record limited to only some equipment used in the batch is a non-conformance (Ref. SOP/QA/BMR-REV/001, LC-01).

parameters.notes: Wet massing endpoint by visual + amperage trend

manufacturing_process_note: Every step listed above must appear in the executed BMR with a recorded actual value; no step may be omitted or marked not-applicable without a documented, QA-approved justification (Ref. SOP/QA/BMR-REV/001, MS-01).
ipqc_note: A compression run exceeding 30 minutes must show multiple IPQC checkpoints at the frequency above; a single checkpoint for a multi-hour run is a Major non-conformance (Ref. SOP/QA/BMR-REV/001, QC-01).
yield_note: Yield must be recorded and reconciled at EACH stage listed above, not compression only. Any reject/rework quantity must be recorded with reason and disposition (Ref. SOP/QA/BMR-REV/001, YR-01, YR-03).

packaging_requirements.standard_requirement: Mandatory, QA-signed, prior to start of any packaging operation
Issued vs. Used vs. Destroyed/Returned must reconcile to 100% of quantity issued
One specimen of each printed packaging component to be retained/affixed in the BMR

approved_equipment_class: Granulation: RMG-02 (or qualified equivalent). Drying: FBD-03. Blending: OCT-BLND-01. Compression: CP-05 or CP-06 (backup, qualified). Coating: CT-01. Only equipment listed as "In-service" with a current (non-expired) calibration status in the Equipment Log may be used (Ref. SOP/QA/BMR-REV/001, XR-02, EL-04).

revision_history.description_of_change: Revised hardness spec range from 4.5–6.5 kp to 4.0–6.0 kp per stability data
Added explicit IPQC frequency table and per-stage yield reconciliation requirement
